en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a dense European city center with canals. Two main canals run through the scene, lined with multi‑storey stone and brick buildings. Several bridges cross the waterways, and there is a prominent church-like building with a tower near one of the canals. Along the bottom edge there is printed caption text identifying the view, and a small publisher's mark is visible in the lower right corner.
